editorial:
Imagine it is 1988, and you are hanging out with your best friend in a world of big hair and neon clothes. That is exactly where you start with Abby and Gretchen. They have been tight since elementary school, but everything changes after a late-night swim that goes south. Suddenly, Gretchen starts acting weird, mean, and totally unlike herself. You will feel the tension as Abby realizes her pal is not just having a mood swing, but is actually possessed by a demon. It feels like a fun throwback to the eighties with a spooky twist that keeps things fresh.

The acting is a huge win here, especially since the girls make their friendship feel real. While some of the scares are a bit predictable, the comedy hits the right notes and keeps the story moving fast. If you love movies that balance laughs with creepy moments, you will really enjoy this one. It is a great pick for a group of friends to watch together.
endingExplained: In the final act, Abby finds a way to cast the demon out of Gretchen. After a scary battle and some help from a local expert, the demon is forced out of her friend's body and sent back to hell. The movie ends with the two girls reuniting and their bond becoming stronger than ever. They realize that their love and loyalty were the keys to winning the fight against the devil.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s nostalgia and spooky stories with a heart.
